body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 3 units. This movement does not trigger Reactions caused solely by leaving an enemy's reach.

surges.html: Draw, conceal, place, or interact with one small carried or unattended item as part of this Action.
After moving, choose one enemy that could see you before or after the movement; learn whether it has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.

rider.title: EVASION CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: An enemy follows your movement and ends adjacent to you. Effect: Move 1 additional unit.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
